question: Does the newly surfaced citation to page 593 of the 2022 Zhonghua edition of Gu Tinglong's diary close the exact published page for the 1950-01-06 Tieqin transaction entry?
answer: No. The public Library Journal article exposes reference [40] only as Gu Tinglong Diary (2022), p.593; its public HTML does not expose the in-text citation context needed to bind p.593 to 1950-01-06. Separately, search-index text from a Peking University-hosted academic PDF explicitly associates 1951-12-25 with Gu Tinglong Diary p.595. Because the PDF itself could not be opened/screenshot in the current public browser route, that second control remains search-index text rather than direct page-image collation. Together these controls make p.593 unsafe as a Jan-6 locator: no p.593→1950-01-06 binding is authorized, and Batch 12FV's exact Jan-6 published page remains UNRESOLVED.
